summary: No local edit capability for catalog entries.
claim: No local edit capability for catalog entries.

evidence.source: Detail composable in MainActivity.kt displays metadata and offers only 'Prepare verified NFC write'; no edit button. The only local record creation is the FAB 'Custom filament' or editing a decoded tag. No function in MainViewModel converts a CatalogEntry to a Provenance.CATALOG_EDITED record.

suggested_remediation: Add an 'Edit locally' action in Detail that opens a pre-populated form (including temperatures) and saves a CATALOG_EDITED record preserving original values and per-field provenance.
suggested_validation: Select a catalog entry, modify a field, save. Verify the edited record appears, original source/provenance is retained per field, and data survives catalog replacement.
